newsitem.title: USA: Sportmart Q4 Feb 2 loss widens after charge.
newsitem.headline: Sportmart Q4 Feb 2 loss widens after charge.

text.p: Sportmart Inc reported a wider loss in the fourth quarter than one year ago after it took a $20.6 million charge as part of its exit from Canada.
The retailer reported a net loss of $28.1 million, or $2.19 a share, in the period ended February 2, compared to a loss of $8.8 million, or $0.69 a share, a year earlier.
Sales slipped to $140.7 million from $150.1 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996.
The company blamed the sales decline on continued soft sales in hard goods, excluding golf, and an unexpected drop in the fitness glider business.
Sportmart officials said the liquidation of its Canadian inventory should be completed by mid-April, adding that the company received tax refunds of $10.3 million in March.
Sportmart operates 59 sporting good stores nationwide.
Its shares were off 3/8 Wednesday at 3-3/8.
